message.content: The company faces the risk that supply chain constraints will act as a governor on near-term revenue conversion, which would be confirmed if management states that the supply environment is less flexible than a year ago [D3]. The risk of one-time tariff impacts artificially inflating current profitability without repeating in future periods exists, which would be confirmed if executives caution that these specific impacts won't repeat [D3]. A risk regarding the sustainability of high order levels exists, which would be confirmed if management expresses confidence that orders will remain slightly up from Q3 in line with seasonality [D4]. The risk that supply chain limitations versus demand fulfillment will cause revenue conversion to be nonlinear over the next few quarters exists, which would be confirmed if management notes that internal capacity constraints have been resolved but external component supply remains a challenge [D4].
